A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''wampa''' attacked [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Lanteel Glacier/Legends|Lanteel Glacier]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], defeating him in one blow by knocking him out and killing his [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]]. He then unceremoniously dragged the unconscious Luke to his cave.

==Behind the scenes==
The book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' establishes that the wampa that attacked Luke when he was riding his tauntaun is not the same wampa in the ice [[Cave/Legends|cave]]. The book labels the events before and during the Battle of Hoth and clearly describes both a male and female wampa; the latter identified as [[One-Arm]], portrayed by ILM employee [[Howie Weed]] during filming of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'' (Special Edition)]].
